entities.summary: Jaden Schwartz is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a left winger and alternate captain for the Seattle Kraken of the National Hockey League (NHL). Schwartz was selected 14th overall by the St. Louis Blues in the 2010 NHL entry draft.
